2026-09-24.text: Stormy day today with NW winds. Tsawwassen may see some upper teens to 20 knots, and tides look just ok from 1pm at 8 feet but rising, so if wind comes in the afternoon there should be plenty of water for foils (not sure about the weed situation). Stevenson will be an option as well, and conditions with a lowish tide may line up for some swell in the river. Jericho may see low teens to upper teens as well starting at noon. Squamish will turn some inflow, however I expect it will be gusty given the cloud cover, and if you're an early riser, Porteau may have some outflow in the high teens to low 20s.

2026-09-23.text: Rest day! If you're really keen to get out, your best bet is Squamish with up and down, probably gusty winds in the teens today, maybe hitting 18 to 20 at times if the thermal difference materializes. The rest of the region will see some light SE winds too, but I don't think it'll top 10 knots at times. Best thing to do today is rest! Looks like Friday may be a Stevenson's day early in the morning, stay tuned.

2026-09-22.text: Some low-teens SE winds over the southern region — Boundary Bay, Ferry Terminal, and East Beach may be possible this evening. Maybe enough for kitefoiling, but tides will be super high, making East Beach disappear, so Boundary and Ferry Terminal could be the better light-wind options. If you want a good powered session, Squamish will see mid-20s for sure with a thermal push, and lighter winds at Porteau.

2026-09-21.text: Very light winds around the region again — the only change today is once more Squamish, which Environment Canada is calling for 20 kt inflow, but I think the thermal will show something very similar to what we saw yesterday. Expecting a similar pattern to yesterday, with winds in the 20s.

2026-09-20.text: An upper-level ridge is holding firm over BC, keeping things sunny with thermal winds taking over in the early afternoon. Squamish is the only spot showing wind, easily hitting low to mid-20s SSW. Head that way and enjoy the sun for a couple more days; systems start moving in Tuesday, so things will look a bit different after that.

2026-09-19.text: Models continue to show very light to no wind across the region. A weak SSW gradient has Bellingham and maybe Boundary Bay with an outside shot at near 10 kt in the back half of the morning, but otherwise skies clearing (after morning marine clouds burn off) and sun will be the biggest factor today. Squamish remains the only real wind spot, building well into the mid-20s SSW, and Porteau may fill in too, just lighter. Not much going on anywhere else, so head to Squamish; just keep in mind there's paving happening along the Sea to Sky, so expect some backup traffic on the way.

2026-09-18.text: Models look pretty flat all over the Strait for the entire weekend. I believe Squamish is the only reliable spot in the region today and this weekend — maybe Porteau will get something too, but lighter than Squamish. I don't see any other wind anywhere today or over the weekend, with light frontal winds returning Sunday afternoon.
